name: ops-issue-loop
description: The orchestration loop: work a backlog of `ops/ready-for-ai` issues to CI-green PRs by commanding the repo's own `ops-change` (implement → verify) once per issue. It owns the loop only — the queue, the durable /goal, rolling cap-3 dispatch, model selection per issue, the 8-attempt CI-green cap and the backstops — and knows nothing about how to build any product. It stops at a green PR: it never merges and never applies the landing label, so there stays exactly one merge path behind one human gate. Bundles `ops-rework-loop`, the label-triggered review-response half, which pushes and hands the PR back rather than landing its own fix. Repo-agnostic; requires ops-capabilities, github-ops, and the repo's `ops-change`.
